command: set -eu; echo '=== HOST/TIME ==='; hostname; date -Is; echo '=== WORKSPACE ==='; find /workspace -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type d -print | sort | head -160; P=/workspace/entityos-crush-omega; echo '=== TARGET ==='; if [ ! -d "$P" ]; then echo TARGET_MISSING:$P; exit 3; fi; cd "$P"; pwd; echo '=== GIT ==='; git status --short --branch || true; git rev-parse HEAD || true; git log -12 --date=iso-strict --pretty=format:'%h %ad %s' || true; echo; echo '=== TOP TREE ==='; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort | head -220; echo '=== OMEGA/CRUSH REFERENCES ==='; grep -RInE 'OMEGA|CRUSH|GRID|UnifiedDB|free.pool|Free.Pool|provider|reentry|TITAN' --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*.lock' . 2>/dev/null | head -260 || true; echo '=== TEST BUILD SURFACES ==='; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | grep -E '/(README[^/]*|Makefile|package.json|pyproject.toml|go.mod|[^/]*(TEST|STATUS|TODO)[^/]*)$' | sort | head -160 || true; echo '=== RECENT DIFF STAT ==='; git diff --stat || true; git diff --cached --stat || true; echo '=== DONE ==='
